newsitem.title: USA: CVS says 5 agencies to vie for ad contract.
newsitem.headline: CVS says 5 agencies to vie for ad contract.

text.p: CVS Corp said Friday it selected five New York advertising firms as finalists in the drug store chain's search for a new ad agency.
CVS said its current agency, Ingalls, Quinn and Johnson, of Boston, declined to participate in the competition.

The agencies in the creative review are the Bates USA unit of Cordiant Plc ; Grey Advertising Inc ; Publicis/Bloom Inc; the Wells Rich Green BDDP Advertising unit of GGT Group Plc and Young and Rubicam Inc.
CVS senior vice president of advertising Jack said the company expects to make a decision by July 15.
